scan.title: Scan cards
scan.intro: Upload photos or scans of cards. Each image is matched against the selected game's catalog on the server; review the matches, correct any that are wrong, then add them to a location.

props.foilDetected: Foil — star (★) read from the card
props.nonFoilDetected: Non-foil — dot (•) read from the card

controls.seedHint: Game / sets / language / condition / foil above seed each new scan; edit any card (or several at once) below before committing.
controls.languageHelp: Auto reads the language printed on MTG and Yu-Gi-Oh! cards; otherwise pick the language of the cards you’re scanning.

commit.addedNote: Only confirmed & checked scans are added.
commit.addedNoteFiltered: Only confirmed & checked scans are added, and only those shown by the current filter.

export.hint: Download the checked, matched scans without adding them to your collection. They stay in this list, so you can still add them later. Confirming isn't required.
export.zipIntro_one: Exports {{count}} checked scan once per chosen format, in a single .zip. Nothing is added to your collection.
export.zipIntro_other: Exports {{count}} checked scans once per chosen format, in a single .zip. Nothing is added to your collection.
export.success_one: Exported {{count}} scan. It's still in the list.
export.success_other: Exported {{count}} scans. They're still in the list.

session.restored_one: Restored {{count}} scan from your last session.
session.restored_other: Restored {{count}} scans from your last session.

audit.title: Audit: {{location}}
audit.banner: Scan every card physically in this location, confirm the matches, then commit. Committing makes this scan the source of truth for the location: matched cards are kept, cards not scanned are removed, and new cards are added.
audit.commitHint: Only confirmed & checked scans count toward the audit.

summary.title: Audit complete: {{location}}
summary.updated: Overwrote condition/foil on {{count}} matched card(s) from the scan.
summary.matchedEmpty: No cards matched what was already here.
summary.notFoundEmpty: Every card previously here was found.

master.deleteBody_one: The checked scan will be removed from this session. This can't be undone.
master.deleteBody_other: The {{count}} checked scans will be removed from this session. This can't be undone.
master.deleteBatchBody_one: The checked scan and its stored image will be removed from this batch. This can't be undone. The original file stays in the folder's _processed subfolder.
master.deleteBatchBody_other: The {{count}} checked scans and their stored images will be removed from this batch. This can't be undone. The original files stay in the folder's _processed subfolder.
master.noMatchFilter: No scans match the current filter.

detail.noConfidentMatch: No confident match. Use “Search catalog” to pick the correct card, or “View scan” to read it.
detail.selectPrompt: Select a scanned card to review it.

keyboard.hint: Press Enter to confirm and go to the next card
keyboard.tapHint: Tap a card to review it
keyboard.waiting_one: Waiting for {{count}} card to finish matching
keyboard.waiting_other: Waiting for {{count}} cards to finish matching
keyboard.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboard.confirmTooltip: Confirm and go to the next card (Enter)
keyboard.footnote: Shortcuts don't work while you're typing in a field. Click an empty part of the page first.

keys.confirm: Confirm the match and go to the next card to review. On a card with no match, opens Search catalog.
keys.exclude: Exclude from commit and go to the next card (press again to include it)
keys.undo: Undo the last confirm, correction or exclude

correction.searchingAllSets: Searching all sets — pick “Sets (art fallback)” above to narrow.

bulk.help: Tick a property to apply it to every checked card. Unticked properties are left unchanged.

value.newTooltip: New — not in your collection yet

listReprint.label: The List
listReprint.tooltip: The List (plst) reprint — an official, cheaper printing. Matched to the plst printing.
listReprint.unresolvedTooltip: Detected as a The List reprint, but its plst printing wasn't found in the catalog — the printing and price shown may be the more expensive original. Check before adding.

batches.title: Batch: {{name}}
batches.intro: Scans saved to a watched folder stay untouched there until their batch starts: when you press Run, or by itself once its files stop changing. Then they're matched in the background. Open a batch to review it and add it to a location.
batches.runHint: Automatic processing is off. Files stay untouched in the scan folder until you press Run.
batches.awaitingRunNotice: This batch hasn't started yet. Its files stay untouched in the scan folder until you press Run.
batches.duplicatesBody: These files were byte-for-byte copies of images already picked up — usually the capture software saving the same run again. They were not matched and won't be added.
batches.discardBody: Discard “{{name}}”? Its {{count}} unsaved card(s) and their stored images will be deleted.
batches.discardOriginalsKept: The original files stay in the folder's _processed subfolder.
batches.discardOriginalsDeleted: The original files in the folder's _processed subfolder will be deleted too.
batches.readOnly: {{name}} is reviewing this batch. You can look, but changes are turned off.
batches.readOnlyUnclaimed: Nobody is reviewing this batch. Start reviewing it to make changes.
batches.claimLost: You're no longer reviewing this batch (someone else took it over, or it was closed). Your last changes may not have been saved.

tagRules.switchHint: Pre-fill the tags from your tag rules (Administration ▸ Tag Rules) on matching cards. Remove any you don't want before adding.
tagRules.chipHint: Added by a tag rule. Remove it to keep it off this card.

validation.label: Validation rule
validation.placeholder: Search syntax every card should match, e.g. set:dom r>=rare
validation.hint: Press Validate to check every scan against the rule. Cards that don't match are flagged; each run replaces the last results.
validation.noSavedRules: No saved rules for this game
validation.deleteBody: Delete the saved rule "{{name}}"? Everyone who scans this game shares it.
validation.showFailed: Show only the cards that failed
validation.skipped_one: {{count}} card was still matching and wasn't checked.
validation.skipped_other: {{count}} cards were still matching and weren't checked.
validation.stale: The rule changed since the last run. Press Validate to check again.
validation.detailFailed: This card doesn't match the validation rule: {{query}}
validation.detailFailedNoMatch: This scan has no matched card, so it can't pass the validation rule: {{query}}
